item.title: FDA approves first CRISPR gene therapy for sickle cell disease
item.description: Regulators cleared a one-time treatment that edits patients' own blood stem cells, marking the first approval of a CRISPR-based medicine in the country. Analysts expect a list price near two million dollars.

item.title: Biotech startup raises 120 million dollars for mRNA cancer vaccine trials
item.description: The Series B round will fund two mid-stage trials of a personalized mRNA vaccine designed to train the immune system against a patient's specific tumor mutations.

item.title: Large study links gut microbiome diversity to slower cognitive decline
item.description: Researchers following 8,000 older adults for a decade report that greater bacterial diversity in the gut was associated with measurably slower memory decline, though they caution the link is not yet proven to be causal.

item.title: AI model predicts protein folding for entire malaria parasite proteome
item.description: A public database now offers predicted structures for thousands of previously uncharacterized proteins, which scientists hope will speed the search for new antimalarial drug targets.
